Chapter 493: Chapter 2: Ranking of Human Civilization Evolution Paths (Subscribe Please)_2

His talent and aptitude were sufficient to rank in the top ten, even top twenty, in the annals of human history.

“An Eighth Stage of Martial Arts already created so quickly?” Xia Qin Supreme Being found it somewhat unbelievable. Completing the Eighth Stage of Martial Arts meant that Lin Yuan had thoroughly completed the Eighth Stage.

But how long had Lin Yuan stepped into the Eighth Stage? Moreover, Xia Qin Supreme Being deeply understood the difficulty of establishing the Eighth Stage Chapter.

In such a short period, progressing from the early phase of the Eighth Stage to the peak was very hard to achieve, let alone creating the Eighth Stage Chapter from scratch.

Xia Qin Supreme Being, overlooking the Cosmic Starry Sky, had seen countless geniuses. When he first met Lin Yuan, he recognized that his talent was among the top ten or twenty in the history of human civilization, yet he felt little emotional fluctuation.

Being among the top ten or twenty in human history was indeed monstrous, but it was just monstrous, and if one didn’t become a Supreme Being, one would eventually fade from history.

...

However, now, with Lin Yuan pioneering the Eighth Stage Chapter, Xia Qin Supreme Being was genuinely astounded.

This was too fast.

The three goddesses wouldn’t deceive him. If the Eighth Stage Chapter created by Lin Yuan didn’t meet the standards, it would have been outright rejected.

Since they informed them, the Supreme Beings, to confirm it, it was the three goddesses believing the Eighth Stage Chapter had no issues.

“Let me take a look…” Xia Qin Supreme Being immediately reviewed the content of the Eighth Stage Martial Tao.

At the level of Supreme Beings, reviewing the Eighth Stage Chapter was not difficult at all. Soon, the three Supreme Beings had finished reviewing the Eighth Stage Martial Tao.

“This Eighth Stage Chapter…” Xia Qin Supreme Being fell into thought, even with his level, he could perceive the potential of the Eighth Stage Martial Tao.

It encompassed all paths of power, practically including all forms of strength, and Xia Qin could even sense that the Eighth Stage Chapter of the Martial Arts Evolution System could extend into various Cosmic Forces.

“Has the identity of this Evolutionary Path’s founder been confirmed? Is he not an alien pawn?” Ancient Power Supreme Being, having finished reading, directly asked the Goddess of Wisdom.

He saw the potential of the Martial Arts Evolution System and had to ensure that its creator was of the Human Race.

Otherwise, it would prompt human civilization to resort to relentless assassination.

“He is of the Human Race.”

“Xia Qin Supreme Being has also personally confirmed it.”

The Goddess of Wisdom answered.

“Xia Qin confirmed it, huh…” Ancient Power Supreme Being nodded slightly, asking no further questions and giving no comment.

However, from the swift confirmation request to the Goddess of Wisdom about the Martial Tao founder’s background, one could see the importance this Supreme Being attached.

Kill if not of our race.

“Xia Qin, your insight is not bad…” Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, a graceful woman, glanced at Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Among the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being was very special, being the ultimate of the Virtual World Evolutionary Path and not skilled in direct combat.

Yet, the importance of Feather Butterfly Supreme Being to human civilization was no less than any other Supreme Being, as the virtual world that covered the territory of human civilization stemmed from Feather Butterfly Supreme Being’s “authority”.

“Hehe…..” Xia Qin Supreme Being smiled slightly.

Not long ago, he met Lin Yuan and, after awarding him the Soul-Settling Pearl, still felt it was not secure, so he asked Feather Butterfly Supreme Being to pay extra attention to Lin Yuan.

Being the origin of the virtual world, the network of which encompassed territories was within Feather Butterfly Supreme Being’s sensing range.

Asking Feather Butterfly Supreme Being to watch Lin Yuan essentially eliminated the possibility of other alien races upsetting the situation by sending Ninth Rank or higher beings to assassinate Lin Yuan.

Of course, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being was just keeping an extra eye on Lin Yuan, not acting as a “nanny”.

Unless Lin Yuan faced the risk of complete downfall, where all avatars and the main body died and resurrection was impossible, would Feather Butterfly Supreme Being step in to interfere.

As for other dangers?

In the eyes of Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, facing moderate danger or life-threatening peril was actually a good thing.

“Xia Qin Supreme Being, Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, Ancient Power Supreme Being, since you have no objections after discussing, this Eighth Stage Chapter, valued at twenty-two million merit points, do you agree?”

The Goddess of Wisdom spoke again.

“Twenty-two million merit points?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s expression remained calm.

A normal Evolutionary Path’s Eighth Stage Chapter typically ranged from eight million to ten million merit points.

An exceptionally good Eighth Stage Chapter might reach fifteen to eighteen million merit points.

An Eighth Stage Chapter exceeding twenty-two million merit points was not merely excellent, but possessed a unique specialty.

“I agree.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being nodded.

“I agree.”

“I agree too.”

Feather Butterfly Supreme Being and Ancient Power Supreme Being also nodded in succession.

The various Cosmic Forces involved in the Eighth Stage Martial Tao fully justified its merit point value.

That was the power of the cosmos. Even grasping just one type would bring great benefits after stepping into the Ninth Rank.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness connected to the Virtual World, and he entered the shopping interface to select suitable energy crystals.

The inner world spanned over twenty million miles and needed to be expanded, and Lin Yuan now urgently needed a large amount of energy to support the Virtual World.

As for slowly absorbing energy from the universe? That method was far too inefficient, and massively absorbing energy from the universe would bring irreparable effects to the Milky Way Main Star.

“This one then.”

Lin Yuan finally made a choice.

Tai Micro Clear Crystal.

The core energy from the Universe Mystery Tai Micro Secret Realm.

Although its material quality was not as pure as the Red Spirit Fluid from the Red Kun Lineage.

But it was more than sufficient for the expansion of the inner world.

“Eighty thousand Cubic Cosmic Crystals…” Lin Yuan estimated the cost needed for the expansion of the inner world to thirty-seven million five hundred thousand miles and immediately felt as though his heart was bleeding.

He had employed thunderous methods to scour the special beings and Alien Lone Walkers in the Milky Way Star Region, obtaining treasures valued at just over one hundred thousand Cubic Cosmic Crystals.

These had barely warmed up when he had to spend a part again.

“It doesn’t matter, as long as I become stronger, killing a few Alien Strong Ones will make it all come back, right? Eighty thousand Cubic Cosmic Crystals? It’s just the price of a half Eighth Stage invincible being…”

Lin Yuan consoled himself, while painfully transferring out the Cosmic Crystals.

“Will it arrive soon?”

Lin Yuan checked the delivery time; the Tai Micro Clear Crystal worth eighty thousand Cubic Cosmic Crystals would arrive at the Milky Way Main Star in about half a month.

“Next, let the Power of Creation inside the inner world transform entirely into Cosmic Force.” Lin Yuan began to remove the isolation of the inner world from the outside world.

In an instant.

Dozens of types of Power of Creation began to actively adapt to the Main World, especially that strand of Primal Force, whose vibrations nearly shook the inner world of ten million miles.

“Once the inner world expands to thirty-seven million five hundred thousand miles, I’ll start absorbing the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd, expanding it to near one hundred million miles.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

With the Spirit Realm continuously absorbing the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd, the enhancement it brings to the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Blood Rebirth’ was substantial.

Next, Lin Yuan reabsorbing it once more would not take much time; just over ten days would suffice for recovery.

…

Half a day later.

The voice of the Goddess of Wisdom suddenly came.

“Respected Galaxy Master, the evaluation of your uploaded Eighth Layer Part has been completed…”

“Completed?” Lin Yuan’s eyes brightened, and he immediately asked, “Worth how many Merit Points?”

“Respected Galaxy Master, the Eighth Layer Part you uploaded is valued at twenty-two million Merit Points…”

The tone of the Goddess of Wisdom was solemn and cold.

“Twenty-two million Merit Points…” Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

He remembered that the Seventh Rank Chapter was valued at only three million Merit Points.

Now, the Eighth Layer Part was valued at twenty-two million Merit Points, achieving an increase of eight to nine times.

“The three Goddesses highly rated the Eighth Layer Part?” Lin Yuan thought silently, “or perhaps it’s not just the three Goddesses?”

The time taken by the three Goddesses to evaluate the Eighth Layer Part this time was much longer than before.

“Twenty-two million Merit Points…” Lin Yuan’s face showed a smile; that was equivalent to the Merit Points obtained from completely killing over twenty Eighth Rank strong beings.

These were complete kills, not just killing an avatar or similar.

In the Battlefields of Different Races, killing over twenty Eighth Rank of Different Species was as difficult as reaching the heavens.

This wasn’t a matter of strength but the fact that after an Evolver had killed three or four Eighth Rank Different Species, all the Alien Strong Ones would take notice, and those Eighth Rank aliens would turn and run at the sight of you.

Any human Evolver, who had killed more than a dozen Eighth Rank Aliens, just had to appear on any alien battlefield and would immediately face counterparts, even Eighth Stage invincible beings.

“Right.”

“Let’s look at the rankings.”

With a thought, Lin Yuan looked toward the latest rankings in the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.
